payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Backend Controller and Evaluation Endpoints (M2.1)
payload.objective: Perform a read-only architectural and migration-scope analysis of the R21 Major Project Backend Controller and Evaluation Endpoints unit and determine the exact first implementation slice.
payload.explicit_request: Review the read-only architectural analysis and scope definition for M2.1 (task 'M2.1-ANALYZE-001'). Provide architectural evaluation, approve the plan or issue the first implementation dispatch (M2.1-IMPLEMENT-001).

task_report.summary: Read-only architectural analysis of M2.1 completed. Discovered legacy files, target gaps, 11 controller endpoints, 2 database tables, AttainmentService dependency, and confirmed ZERO coupling with AttendanceController. Proposed 2-slice decomposition with M2.1-IMPLEMENT-001 as first concrete task.

tests.read_only_audit: PASSED (0 repository files modified, 0 database modifications)

payload.reason: The M2.1 analysis is sufficient to establish a controlled implementation boundary. M1.1 is COMPLETED, satisfying the dependency gate. The report identifies the complete backend surface, the two required R21 Major Project models, the schema migration, AttainmentService dependency, controller, routes, and dedicated verification artifacts. The reported absence of hard AttendanceController coupling removes M4.1 as a prerequisite. The proposed two-slice decomposition is architecturally sound: establish schema/model parity first, verify it independently, then introduce the service/controller/routes with feature-level endpoint verification. This prevents controller work from being built against an unverified persistence layer and keeps M2.2 frontend and M2.3 print-report concerns outside the current unit. The proposed whitelist is appropriately explicit. One implementation constraint is mandatory: the migration and models must be compared against the actual legacy definitions and existing target conventions before being altered, and AttainmentService must not be introduced merely as an unexamined copy if target architecture requires compatibility adjustments. No changes outside the approved whitelist are authorized. The correct next state is READY, with M2.1-IMPLEMENT-001 as the first implementation slice.
